entities.summary: Owen Diana Omogiafo is a Nigerian business executive and strategist. She is the President and Group Chief Executive Officer of Transnational Corporation Plc, a diversified conglomerate with strategic investments in the Power, Hospitality and Oil and Gas sectors.
